payload.posture: Read Psalms 136:10–16 as one movement in Passover, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states each remembered act—striking Egypt’s firstborn, bringing Israel out, dividing the sea, overthrowing Pharaoh, and leading through wilderness—is answered by the same refrain. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Passover.
